about: A channel sender's identity, as the platform asserts it on a relayed turn (webagents gap-closure plan item 2.2, the channel relay). The portal verifies the webhook, maps the sender to `channel:<type>:<sender id>` and puts it on the `caller` field of the `input.text` frame (`caller.channel = {type, sender_id}`); nothing a client or a message body supplies reaches it. `types` maps a portal provider to the channel type both SDKs name (the vendor is not the type: sendgrid and the mailbox are `email`, twilio is `sms`). `sender_ids` pins the sender-id rule per provider (portal tests/unit/messaging/channel-identity-w2chan.test.ts). `assertions` pin what portalCallerAuth / portal_caller_auth make of the field, the principals the access skill collects (the channel principal first, so it is the memory namespace), and the sentence the model is told (TypeScript tests/unit/access/channel-principals-w2chan.test.ts, Python tests/access/test_channel_principals_w2chan.py).
sender_id_rule: no whitespace, not `*`, at most 200 characters; compared without case

sender_ids.case: slack: the user id behind the channel-scoped contact key
the mailbox: the address behind a mailbox principal, lower-cased
the mailbox: a platform user is not a channel sender
discord: the user behind a guild-mention chat key
whitespace is not a sender id
a wildcard is not a sender id
an unknown provider names no channel

assertions.who: This turn is from the sender 8842 on telegram, relayed by Robutler. Groups: none.

assertions.case: an email sender, with no platform handle
assertions.who: This turn is from the sender alice@example.com on email, relayed by Robutler. Groups: none.
This turn is from the sender U9ABC on slack, relayed by Robutler. Groups: none.

assertions.case: a channel field that is not an object is ignored; the caller stays
assertions.who: This turn is from the Robutler user c4. Groups: none.

assertions.case: a type that is not a slug is ignored
assertions.who: This turn is from the Robutler user c5. Groups: none.

assertions.case: a sender id with whitespace, or a wildcard, is ignored
assertions.who: This turn is from the Robutler user c6. Groups: none.

assertions.case: an empty sender id is ignored
assertions.who: This turn is from the Robutler user c7. Groups: none.

assertions.case: the owner is the owner, never a channel sender
assertions.who: This turn is from this agent's owner.
